description: Interior; full length portrait of Juan Hamilton and Georgia O'Keeffe sitting in wooden chairs in front of the fireplace, in her Abiquiu living room, with their hands folded in their laps, looking directly at the camera. O'Keeffe is dressed in black wearing a white blouse and her Alexander Calder brooch, Juan is dressed in a light colored quilted jacket with a small plaid shirt, kaki colored pants and worn leather cowboy boots.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Juan Hamilton
